overrides.$comment: Forces express-rate-limit past @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's natural ^8.2.1 resolution (8.3.2), which pins its own ip-address dependency to an exact vulnerable 10.1.0 (GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr, high: SSRF via octal/decimal IP-octet confusion; GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g, moderate: XSS). 8.4.0+ declares ip-address as ^10.2.0 instead, resolving to a patched version. Safe to remove once @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's own package.json naturally depends on express-rate-limit >=8.4.0 — check `bun audit` after any @modelcontextprotocol/sdk bump before removing this.
